name: io.github.ukenal/x402ai-mcp
description: Pay-per-call AI tools (embed, summarize, ask) from x402ai, paid in USDC on Base via x402.

environmentVariables.name: X402AI_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Buyer wallet private key (hex), used only to sign payments locally. Needed only for the paid tools. Use a wallet holding only what you are willing to lose.

environmentVariables.name: X402AI_MAX_SESSION_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per server process in USD (default 0.25).

environmentVariables.name: X402AI_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to quote prices without signing or paying.
